newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed after holiday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed after holiday.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mixed, with central U.S. dealers reporting minor price gains on post-holiday buying, dealers said.

Prices were steady to weak in few eastern U.S. markets where feedmixers stocked up ahead of the holiday and were out of the market early this week, dealers said. Also, competing feed ingredients were in ample supply.
"We have hominy falling, gluten falling and soybean hulls falling," said a Carolina dealer, referring to prices of competing ingredients.
A small amount of millfeeds traded in north Texas markets, where dealers said millfeed prices should be near a bottom.

Kansas City rail offers firmed on a slight increase in post-holdiay buying. However, dealers doubt the gains will last because of ample supplies of new-crop wheat and forecasts for flour mills to resume six-day week production schedules. Mill production schedules were reduced last week because of the Independence Day holiday.
